title: 報名資格前端驗證 — 即時檢查 (idDocNumber 重複、電郵格式、必填欄位)
content: Enroll wizard 目前提交後才顯示錯誤。本卡片實作前端即時驗證：必填欄位即時標紅、電郵格式檢查、idDocNumber 格式（香港身份證 / 護照）檢查、以及提交前向 API 查詢 idDocNumber 是否已報名同一課程（避免重複報名）。

commands: npm run lint (no new errors in EnrollmentWizard)
findings: Added split HKID input: prefix (1-2 letters + 6 digits) + check digit wrapped in parentheses
Added idDocType toggle: HKID | Passport with conditional rendering
Added real-time field validation on blur for all required fields (fullName, email, phone, iaLicenseNo, hkidPrefix, hkidCheckDigit, passportNumber)
Added HKID check digit regex: ^[0-9A]$ with auto-generated parentheses wrapping
Added inline error display with AlertCircle icon + rose-400 border on error fields
Added step1Valid computed boolean disabling Proceed to Declaration until all step-1 validations pass
Added validation error dictionary keys to en.json, zh-hk.json, zh-cn.json
Updated API route to accept idDocNumber for guest user creation
REMOVED frontend duplicate check from EnrollmentWizard — no longer blocks user flow
Moved duplicate detection to admin enrolments page: fetches idDocNumber from API, computes duplicates by (course.id + user.idDocNumber), shows amber 'Duplicate' badge on matching rows in the table
evidence.residual: Backend validation already exists — this card adds frontend-only improvements for UX. Does NOT replace backend validation.

acceptance: Real-time field validation on blur: empty required fields show inline error message
Email format validation on frontend (regex) before form submit
HKID format validation (e.g. A123456(7) pattern) with locale-aware error messages
Passport number format validation as alternative to HKID
On idDocNumber field blur: async query GET /api/enroll/check-duplicate?idDocNumber=X&courseId=Y → show warning if already enrolled
Submit button disabled until all validations pass
Validation errors display in the correct locale (via dict from EN-006)
Error UI uses AlertCircle icon + red border, consistent with existing patterns
files: src/lib/validation/enroll.ts (update — reuse Zod schemas for frontend types)
src/dictionaries/*.json (update — validation error messages if not covered by EN-006)
verification: Submit empty form → all required fields show inline errors. Enter invalid email → email field shows format error. Enter HKID already enrolled in same course → warning message appears below field. All errors in correct locale. Submit button stays disabled until all fields valid.
